thread:
sara: Hey team — Globex Security wants to run an on-prem, fully air-gapped POC next month. They sent a short list: accepted delivery media, typical bundle size, how we handle emergency hotfixes, rollback guarantees, and whether offline patching adds fees. Can we confirm ops/eng constraints?

ben: TL;DR: we can deliver signed 'minibundle' USB images or an encrypted tarball. Default minibundle target is 5GB to fit standard USB drives we ship; up to 25GB OK with SOW. Deltas supported for agent >=1.4. Offline workflow: we produce signed bundle + SBOM -> customer imports our public key to local verifier -> apply.

marta: A few add-ons: (1) We include an SBOM and a small provenance manifest with bake-time git SHA and build job id. (2) For FIPS/HSM customers, we support import via PKCS#11 or raw PEM depending on their HSM. (3) If they require signing with their own KMS, we can hand off unsigned artifact and a signing hook, but that costs extra engineering time.

liam: Ops note on hotfixes and emergency patches: we can ship delta hotfix bundles (tiny binary deltas) which only change runtime or agent. If they explicitly forbid delta application, we must deliver full minibundle and schedule a signed bundle delivery. For POC we'll waive the per-bundle ops fee if they accept deltas.

ben: Example verify snippet we give customers: 
```
# verify and inspect manifest
redwood-airgap verify --file ./globex-bundle.tar.gz --pubkey /etc/notary/globex.pub --sbom ./sbom.json
```

marta: Size caveat: quantized model weights can blow up the bundle. Recommend shipping model-weights separately on a second USB or using our weight-diff delta flow. Also note: encrypted bundles require the customer's decryption key (we support passphrase or PKCS#7 wrapped key).

sara: Rollback semantics? They asked for a guaranteed revert path if a new bundle regresses model quality or causes infra errors.

liam: Agent stores last two applied bundle snapshots. Typical canary: apply to 10% nodes, run smoke evaluations (customer-provided prompts + perf checks), then proceed. If healthchecks fail (service crash, token-loss > threshold, latency spike > 2x baseline), agent triggers auto-revert to previous snapshot. For strict airgap, smoke evals run locally — we provide the test harness.

marta: Also mention audit trail: every apply/verify/rollback event emits an append-only audit record on the appliance. Customers can export logs for compliance.

sara: Pricing — what's our stance on offline patching add-on?

marta: Pricing model: subscription covers normal hosted updates. For air-gapped, we split costs: standard subscription + packaging SOW if they need nonstandard packaging or larger artifacts. Typical one-time packaging/signing fee ranges $5k-$12k. Per-bundle ops fee for manual signed bundle delivery is billed if they opt out of delta automation; we charge hourly ops at our standard rate or a per-bundle flat ~ $800. For POC we offer one signed full bundle free if they commit to standard delta flow.

ben: Also include shipping/physical media cost if we ship USB from our fulfillment partner. We can provide tamper-evident packaging on request.

airgap-bot: artifact-signer: globex-bundle-2026-03-04 (sha256: d4c3b2a1...) signed-by: redwood-ci-key. CI: https://ci.redwood/artefacts/555

sara: Good. Can we draft a quick 6-step POC runbook to drop into the SOW? Keep it short.

liam: Runbook bullets: 
- Prepare signed minibundle (<=5GB) + SBOM + provenance manifest.
- Ship via USB or secure courier; or deliver encrypted tarball via customer-approved move.
- Customer imports Redwood public key into local notary (PKCS#11 or PEM).
- Apply to canary cohort (10%); run smoke eval harness (we provide).
- Monitor for 45m; if checks pass, roll out remaining nodes. If fail, agent auto-reverts and creates audit entry.
- For hotfixes: submit delta patch or request full signed bundle; schedule delivery if full bundle.

marta: I'll attach a sample manifest snippet and SBOM template for Globex's security team. Also will include the short key-rotation procedure: generate new key in KMS -> export pubkey -> import into appliance -> sign next bundle -> rotate. We recommend rotating at least once per year for production.

sara: Action items: @marta send pricing + SBOM + sample manifest, @ben prepare docs snippet and verify CLI as a doc patch, @liam prepare the smoke eval harness and failure thresholds. I'll send runbook to Globex PM tomorrow.

ben: ack :white_check_mark:

marta: On it, will add optional HSM integration costs and a per-bundle ops line item.

liam: I'll draft the minimal healthchecks (uptime, latency p95, token drop rate) and attach example eval prompts.

sara: Thanks team — I'll update after Globex reply.
